name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.317.0 — spec-status no longer lets a queued prompt or decide item at the queue head seat itself as the only lane: queue prompt entries are excluded from top-pick and lane admission, so independent hardened specs fan out as parallel lanes while the prompt row still prints first in the Next block; --next order is unchanged. spec-queue's move/done/show/next/list/groom now refuse any unknown --flag (including --root) with exit 2 instead of silently acting on the cwd repo's queue. 7.316.0 — Delegation is a plugin-owned fact: pending-question.js isDelegated(root) reads the spec-delegated marker in the lane's private git dir (new 'mark' subcommand, the fan-out's first worker command) or the lane's branch in the fan-out table, never CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION — the parent session carries that variable too, so the orchestrator read itself as a worker and its merge step printed MERGE_READY. 7.315.0 — Add /spec:fanout — one session runs the lanes: a driver-stepped fan-out over worktree-isolated sub-agents with batched question relay, serial merge with a gate after each, and one rendered report.
